novel_features.name: Deadline Pressure Index
novel_features.description: Ranks all upcoming assignments across all your courses by how much each costs per hour of delay.

novel_features.name: Grade Impact Calculator
novel_features.description: Shows the max and min final grade still achievable in a course given your remaining unsubmitted work.

novel_features.name: Grade Drift Tracker
novel_features.description: Tracks your grade trajectory across syncs and flags courses where your score has dropped since last check.

novel_features.name: Silent Drop Detector
novel_features.description: Flags courses with unread announcements, no recent module completions, and upcoming deadlines — courses slipping off your radar.

novel_features.name: Late Submission Window Detector
novel_features.description: Analyzes your submission history to compute whether an instructor actually accepts late work and by how many days.

novel_features.name: Cross-Course Workload Forecast
novel_features.description: Shows a per-day workload bar chart for the next N weeks across all courses, weighted by submission type effort.

novel_features.name: Pre-Deadline Heads-Up
novel_features.description: Surfaces announcements posted within 72 hours of a due date for assignments you have not yet submitted.

novel_features.name: Module Completion Gap Report
novel_features.description: Shows module completion ratio and flags incomplete items that block downstream graded assignments.
